subject: Re: Acme Corp — POC kickoff & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Wu <jamie.wu@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp — POC kickoff & next steps

Thanks again for a great discussion today — appreciated the time, Jamie and Lena. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off cleanly. Please reply with any corrections or gaps.

TL;DR
- Customer pain: slow search & retrieval for docs, high manual tagging effort, and repeated hallucinations in summarization flows.
- POC goal: reduce mean retrieval latency and improve extractive QA accuracy; reduce manual tagging effort by 60% for the pilot scope.
- Proposed kickoff: 4/20 remote kick-off; data access by 4/21; 2-week baseline + 3-week iteration.

What we heard (pain points)
- Search latency: many queries > 800ms end-to-end for high-cardinality docs.
- Quality: summarization often omits regulatory clauses; extraction precision ~62%.
- Ops: current infra and rate limits prevent safe scale testing.

POC scope (proposed)
- Dataset: subset of product manuals + support tickets (~200k docs, 20k unique users).
- Workloads: retrieval-augmented generation for support summaries + vector search for internal KB.
- Success metrics:
  * Retrieval latency p95 < 300ms (under POC load)
  * Extractive QA F1 >= 80% on our eval set
  * Manual tagging reduced by >= 60% in pilot workflows

Owners
- Acme: Jamie Wu (PM lead), Lena Ortiz (Engineering lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales lead), Rishi Malhotra (technical lead), Aditya Rao (solutions eng)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Confirm kickoff date — proposed Tue 20 Apr (30–45 min).
2) Share a small sample dataset (S3 path or Drive link) and a list of representative queries by 21 Apr.
3) Provide a read-only account for a sample S3 bucket or a Snowflake read role (details in attachment).
4) Point-of-contact for security/compliance questionnaire (if needed).

Attachments: acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf (POC MOP), redwood-access-steps.txt (access checklist).

If that looks right I'll schedule the kickoff and loop in Rishi & Aditya for environment planning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0114

From: Jamie Wu <jamie.wu@acme.com>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — POC kickoff & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful and summarizes the call well. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed: kickoff on Tue 20 Apr works (let's do 10:00am PT).
- Dataset: we can share a 10K doc sample in S3 by 21 Apr. I'll grant a read-only IAM role as requested; I'll send the role ARN separately to Aditya.
- Metrics: the F1 target of 80% looks reasonable as a stretch; baseline precision is 62% as you noted. We'll track both precision and recall.
- Security POC owner: that's me for now; I'll loop Legal if they need to see the questionnaire.

One ask: can Redwood run the first baseline within a sandboxed environment (no egress from our VPC) — we prefer not to share entire data until we've validated the sandbox. If the sandbox flow is a blocker, tell us and we'll consider a scoped subset.

On the kickoff call, please have Rishi ready to go over onboarding steps and required AWS permissions.

Thanks — Jamie

Great — appreciate the quick confirmation, Jamie. Below is a slightly expanded kickoff / plan doc so everyone (internal & Acme) has one place to reference before Tue. I'm attaching the MOP and an access checklist.

POC kickoff recap (finalized)
1) Kickoff meeting
  - Date/time: Tue, 20 Apr 2027, 10:00–10:45am PT (Zoom link to follow)
  - Attendees: Jamie, Lena, Acme Eng+PM; Marissa, Rishi, Aditya from Redwood
2) Scope (final)
  - Ingest: 10k sample docs from Acme S3 (read-only role)
  - Workloads: vector search + RAG summarization for support tickets and manuals
  - Eval: 3 prompt families — extractive QA, short-form summaries (100–200 words), and regulatory clause detection
3) Success metrics & eval plan
  - Baseline run: Redwood will run an initial baseline using the sample data and the supplied prompt set. Baseline windows: 22–24 Apr.
  - Metrics tracked:
    * Retrieval latency: p50/p95 (ms)
    * Extractive QA: Precision, Recall, F1 (target F1 >= 80%)
    * Summary quality: human-rated score on 50 gold queries (target mean >= 4/5)
    * Ops: cost per 1k tokens estimate, throughput at 50 concurrent sessions
  - Evaluations: we'll run automated evals plus a 5-person human review for summary quality. We will share the eval rubric in the Drive link.
4) Prompt sets / evals
  - We'll provide an initial prompt set for each family (attached as prompt_sets_v1.csv in the Drive). Please flag any regulatory-sensitive prompts.
5) Owners & responsibilities
  - Redwood: Rishi (technical onboarding + runtime tuning), Aditya (data ingestion & embeddings), Marissa (POC coordination + success criteria)
  - Acme: Jamie (POC PM), Lena (engineering lead), Security contact TBD
6) Timeline (high-level)
  - 15 Apr: This plan circulated (today)
  - 20 Apr: Kickoff call
  - 21 Apr: ACME shares sample data + IAM role
  - 22–24 Apr: Baseline run & initial eval
  - 25 Apr–12 May: Iteration window (tuning, extra prompts)
  - 13 May: Internal readout / go/no-go decision
7) Access & setup steps (technical)
  - Preferred: Grant Redwood a read-only S3 role scoped to bucket/prefix with sample docs. Role ARN should be emailed to aditya.rao@redwood.com.
  - Sandbox option: If you require sandboxed flow, we can run everything inside your VPC via a temporary deployment — we'll need a short list of allowed egress endpoints and a point of contact to provision.
  - Credentials: We'll use a short-lived infra user for ingestion and rotate keys after the POC.
8) Risks / open questions
  - Full dataset access timeline (affects schedule)
  - Regulatory prompts that may require legal review
Attachments: acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf, redwood-access-steps.txt

Action items (owner)
  - Jamie: Share role ARN + sample S3 path by 21 Apr (Jamie)
  - Marissa: Schedule kickoff + send Zoom link (Marissa)
  - Aditya: Confirm ENV requirements and send exact IAM policy stub (Aditya)
  - Rishi: Prepare baseline runtime config and estimate GPU footprint (Rishi)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0114
